name: SignGraph holds keratin graphs: fiber and sheaf graphs with holes
asks: graphing technology for our work. Keratin graphs, as a way of having fiber/sheaf graphs with holes

met-when.says: A keratin graph is built over a feather graph from supplied stalks, contact tables and face attachments, and is a sheaf on that graph whose restriction maps are checked when it is built.

Each hole, a boundary loop that no attached face fills, is reported with the cells on its boundary, and the count of independent holes equals the first Betti number Metrologic computes for the same complex, in exact arithmetic.
A boundary proposed for filling is reported as proposed and changes no count until a face is attached to it.
Observations on the stalks around a hole are assessed as consistent or inconsistent, and an inconsistency names the cells that disagree.

sources.words: graphing technology for our work. Keratin graphs, as a way of having fiber/sheaf graphs with holes
